name: TagGroup
status: stable — exercised in composed page flows under e2e and axe, beyond the per-component checks
aria: `role="group"` -- identifies the container as a semantic grouping of related elements
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name describing the purpose of the tag collection
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name for the group via `aria-label`
`children`: slot (required) -- tag elements to render inside the group
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the container `<div>`
